canonical_project: Altay Green Low-Carbon Intelligent Computing Center (阿勒泰市绿色低碳智算中心)
notes: Groundbreaking held 2025-04-03 in Altay City (local media); total investment reported RMB2.5bn, planned compute scale 20,000P and 20,000 intelligent-computing cabinets; main structure reported topped out July 2025 (People's Daily).
